cassette.threads: Custom printed8x2 calibration lock and10x2 chassis stop; real matched trapezoids, not ISO
cassette.fasteners: One8mm calibration screw, keeper plate,6.5mm cap push pin, printed hinge hardware
cassette.cap_release_direction: Pull6.5mm pin toward -Y then lift cap; no front clip
cassette.depth_adjustment: Rear abutment encoded in replaceable keyed shim
cassette.lateral_adjustment: Side abutment and bolt bore encoded in replaceable keyed shim
cassette.extraction_retention: Overmold friction requires physical pull testing; squeeze is provisional
cassette.soft_stop: Removable flexible printed bumper,8.2mm socket over8mm stem; fit test required

rear_cable.qualification: Continuation diameter and bend radius are assumptions, not measured Dell cable properties. Reserve a loose exterior loop; no fixed clamp or rigid elbow near the moving outlet.

fastener.family: D7 custom trapezoidal matched pair; not ISO metric
fastener.print_orientation: Screw knob flat on bed, shaft upright; nut axis upright
fastener.qualification: PETG fit and hand torque coupon required; no strength certification

body_service.gasket: 0.2 mm self-adhesive closed-cell perimeter tape, compressed at the flange; terminate beside the cable saddle

cable_routing.service: Lay the cable into the open cover-edge groove, then close the panel. The tunnel captures with clearance; it must not crush insulation. Keep ties and wiring on the shell when removing the panel.
cable_routing.qualification: Actual fan lead, plug connector, bend radius and tie head are not modeled. Fit the intended fan and cable before fixing a route.
